title: StoryCompact
description: A story represents an activity associated with an object in the Asana system.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the resource, as a string.

resource_type.description: The base type of this resource.

comment_gid.description: *Conditional*. The GID of this comment's envelope, distinct from the story `gid`. Request with `opt_fields=comment_gid` on story reads. For a top-level task comment, pass this value as `parent_comment` when creating a threaded reply. Null for a legacy comment without an envelope; absent on non-comment stories.

anchor_gid.description: *Conditional*. The GID of the object this comment is anchored to. For a top-level task comment this is the task GID; for a threaded reply this is the parent comment's envelope GID (`comment_gid`). Also present on sticker stories. Request with `opt_fields=anchor_gid` on story reads.

created_at.description: The time at which this resource was created.

resource_subtype.description: The subtype of this resource. Different subtypes retain many of the same fields and behavior, but may render differently in Asana or represent resources with different semantic meaning.

text.description:
*Create-only*. Human-readable text for the story or comment.
This will not include the name of the creator.
*Note: This is not guaranteed to be stable for a given type of story. For example, text for a reassignment may not always say “assigned to …” as the text for a story can both be edited and change based on the language settings of the user making the request.*
Use the `resource_subtype` property to discover the action that created the story.
